candidates.snippet: 1921: Joins the Communist Party of China - Mao Zedong joined the Communist Party of China, marking his formal entry into revolutionary politics. 1927: Leads the Autumn Harvest Uprising - Mao Zedong led the Autumn Harvest Uprising, an early attempt to establish a peasant-based communist revolution. 1934: Begins the Long March - Mao Zedong played a crucial role in the Long March, a strategic military retreat undertaken by the Red Army. 1943: Becomes Chairman of the Communist Party - Mao Zedong was elected Chairman of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, consolidating his leadership.
